response.justification: The candidate is a broadly experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong testing culture and some high-scale systems exposure (low-latency DLang microservices handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby), but he falls well short of the core requirement of 8 years of C++ experience — his C++ work amounts to roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a thesis project. His career centers on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure, and formal technical-leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers is not evidenced.
strengths: High-throughput, low-latency systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (async I/O, fibers, caching)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus teaching/workshop experience
Long, diverse track record including open-source project ownership (GISCollective) and Kubernetes/Docker deployment
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ (~7 months professional C++ experience)
No production cloud compute platform or large-scale infrastructure leadership background
No demonstrated formal technical-lead role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or driving cross-team technical strategy
